authority.alpha_prerequisite: Add the bounded phase and scheduler evidence needed to diagnose the current rrflowKV authoritative batch-write tail before any optimization or benchmark-policy decision. This is a C-07/J-04 diagnostic prerequisite only; canonical roadmap order still names D-01 next, and this package does not close C-07, J-04, POAM-012, or an alpha outcome.

current_behavior: The current format-5 semantic benchmark times each whole ClaimRepository append but cannot attribute latency inside the native transaction. The supplied historical comparison reported native 105306 writes/s versus Fjall 144868 and isolated native trials with 45-126 ms extremes, but that exact run is not retained by the current tree and its format-4 promotion result is not current authority. A clean-baseline format-5 sustained run at 16384 claims, batches of 128, and nine child processes produced median 104839 writes/s and aggregate p50/p95/p99/max batch latency of 1.178/1.471/2.002/2.057 ms, with one 10.005 ms trial maximum. Every trial recorded zero automatic flushes, write stalls, failed flushes, and oversized batches. The workload produces 257 physical mutations per semantic batch and 32896 total versions, far below the 524288-version and 64 MiB WAL maintenance bounds. A one-trial strace characterization observed one fdatasync per authoritative batch. The sequential single-caller harness also has no competing rrflowKV mutex holder. Durability wait, ordinary encode/apply work, allocation/page-fault pressure, and host scheduling remain unseparated.
target_behavior: Keep one native write algorithm and add an explicitly enabled, bounded, process-local diagnostic collector. For every accepted profiled transaction, retain raw mutation/byte/sequence dimensions; semantic begin/commit mutex waits; transaction validation and batch preparation; batch encoding; maintenance/preflight; WAL record/checksum, initial reservation, write, and sync_data; memtable apply; bookkeeping; total wall and thread CPU time; lower-bound memtable-byte growth; and Linux thread resource deltas for minor/major faults, block I/O, and voluntary/involuntary context switches. Disabled collection takes no timestamps, rusage calls, or sample allocations. RrflowKvStore supplies only the adapter lock-wait context and exposes explicit enable/take methods; no StorageEngine or semantic repository contract changes. Benchmark format 6 adds an opt-in --write-path-diagnostics flag, exact raw per-batch records, p99.9, phase distributions, attribution invariants, and measurement-scope labels. Scheduled semantic diagnostics enable the flag and retain their raw artifact. Focused tests prove disabled behavior, bounded overflow accounting, authoritative versus buffered sync classification, maintenance attribution, bridge lock evidence, and raw/summary consistency. Controlled same-workload runs compare instrumentation disabled and enabled and classify the local tail without changing a threshold or status.
unchanged_behavior: README, objective, roadmap, POA&M, and canonical D-01-before-C-07 dependency order retain their existing authority and status.

One rrflowKV transaction still conflict-checks, encodes one WriteBatch, appends one WAL frame, performs the requested durability boundary, and publishes the same owned mutations to the same memtable in the same order.
WAL, batch, manifest, segment, key, application, and benchmark workload semantics remain unchanged; no format compatibility path, second writer, fallback, migration, or provider state is added.
Authoritative claim appends remain Authoritative. No buffered semantic shortcut, group-commit claim, relaxed acknowledgement, or durability-policy change is introduced.
Diagnostics are bounded, process-local, explicitly activated, and replaceable evidence. They are not canonical state, telemetry authority, a lifecycle, an external effect, or a schema of reasoning.
The normal disabled path performs no diagnostic timestamp, thread-resource syscall, sample allocation, trace emission, file write, or environment/network discovery.
The benchmark remains diagnostic rather than release authority. GitHub ubuntu-latest output is not fixed-hardware J-04 qualification, and historical Fjall comparisons stay historical.
Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, product version 1.0.0, thresholds, promotion policy, roadmap/POA&M status, release state, and official origin remain unchanged.

No implementation file is deleted, moved, merged, or replaced; the new diagnostic module is the canonical bounded home for measurement types and platform probes rather than more growth in database.rs.

implementation_changes.action: Create the canonical bounded measurement module. Preallocate only on explicit enable; collect raw accepted-write samples and dropped-sample count; use Instant wall time everywhere and Linux CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID plus RUSAGE_THREAD where available, with explicit unavailable fields elsewhere.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Reject zero or excessive capacities before activation; never panic or change a write result because a diagnostic clock/resource probe is unavailable; saturate measurement deltas; retain raw values rather than a verdict.

implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Do not expose collector internals, an activation side effect, or a second storage authority.

implementation_changes.action: Thread one optional measurement record through the existing transaction/write algorithm; time validation, batch construction/encoding, maintenance, memtable apply, bookkeeping, and total; capture maintenance deltas and O(1) memtable-byte growth; accept adapter lock context; record only completed writes.

research.reason: The existing reviewed research supplies the benchmark/optimization method. Fresh primary documentation is required for the exact durability and Linux thread-resource probes used by the new measurement contract; no upstream engine code or policy is adopted.

sources.title: Rust std::fs::File::sync_data
sources.retained_behavior: Name and time the exact Rust content-synchronization call already used by authoritative WAL appends, while preserving its platform caveat.
sources.rejected_assumption: A short sync_data duration proves the storage device or directory entry is universally durable.

sources.title: Linux clock_gettime(2)
sources.retained_behavior: Use CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID only as calling-thread CPU consumed, paired with monotonic Instant wall duration.
sources.rejected_assumption: Wall minus thread CPU alone distinguishes every scheduler and I/O wait cause.

sources.title: Linux getrusage(2)
sources.retained_behavior: Use RUSAGE_THREAD deltas for minor/major faults, block I/O, and voluntary/involuntary context switches, and label the fields Linux-specific.
sources.rejected_assumption: A context-switch or page-fault counter by itself proves lock contention or allocator causality.

sources.title: Linux fsync(2) and fdatasync(2)
sources.retained_behavior: Interpret sync_data wall time as a blocking durability boundary that may include data and required metadata completion.
sources.rejected_assumption: Changing or removing the sync is a valid optimization without a new acknowledgement contract and crash evidence.

runtime_trace.reason: Add no tracing span/event or always-on telemetry. Exact raw diagnostic structs avoid high-cardinality production emission and remain explicitly benchmark-owned.

resource_evidence.reason: Retain per-batch bytes, lower-bound mutable growth, wall/thread-CPU phase durations, Linux faults/block-I/O/context-switch deltas, maintenance deltas, dropped samples, and raw distributions.

debugging_evidence.reason: A tail sample can be attributed to adapter locks, transaction/encoding, maintenance, WAL record/reservation/write/sync, memtable apply, bookkeeping, or unattributed/off-CPU time without changing semantic execution.

first_failure_oracle: The supplied native tail cannot be reproduced as current authority because its exact format-4 artifact is absent; preserve that evidence gap rather than reverse-engineering a promotion result from historical prose.

The clean-baseline sustained format-5 run records 104839 writes/s but no phase below whole append and no p99.9; zero maintenance counters disprove automatic flush/compaction for that run but cannot classify sync versus scheduling.

stop_conditions: A diagnostic requires weakening Authoritative durability, changing acknowledgement, bypassing ClaimRepository/RrflowKvStore, reviving Fjall, changing a threshold, or creating a second write algorithm.
Disabled operation would execute timestamps, getrusage/clock_gettime probes, allocate samples, emit detailed tracing, or persist diagnostic state.
The collector is unbounded, silently drops without a count, records semantic content/keys/values, or lets a diagnostic failure alter a storage result.
Phase measurement changes WAL bytes, frame count, sync_data placement, failure injection, poisoning, sequence allocation, transaction conflicts, memtable visibility, recovery, or maintenance policy.
Lock measurement requires changing the provider-neutral StorageEngine/StorageTransaction contract or adds a parallel lifecycle/telemetry authority.
Portable builds cannot represent unavailable Linux resource fields explicitly, or Linux probes use process-wide rather than calling-thread measurements.
The benchmark cannot prove one raw native record per semantic batch, phase arithmetic, p99.9, no drops, exact workload config, correctness, and clear aggregate/raw ownership.
Controlled evidence is noisy, irreproducible, or insufficient to distinguish causes; report the remaining ambiguity and do not optimize or alter policy.

Cargo.lock/version/status changes, any owning test regresses, generated navigation/inventory drifts, or scope expands into C-07 completion, fixed-hardware promotion, runtime telemetry, group commit, async I/O, allocator replacement, or release work.
